rationale: Kshitij brings deep expertise in semiconductor verification and chip design—domains where robust infrastructure and tooling are critical—while Sharon is building production-ready AI agent infrastructure. Their skill sets are complementary: Kshitij's systems-level thinking and protocol expertise could inform how agentic AI systems handle complex, safety-critical workflows, and Sharon's AI agent platform could eventually serve verification and chip design teams looking to automate testing and IP validation.
intro_message: Kshitij, meet Sharon — she's building production AI agent infrastructure at TheAgentic.Ai, and your verification and protocol expertise could offer valuable perspective on how agents handle complex, safety-critical domains like chip design.
